# Credify

> Business-financing partner that places capital for operators denied by banks and platforms. $100K minimum approval (guaranteed on accepted files), 100+ private lending partners, $840M+ delivered, funded in 24 hours to 6 days. No minimum FICO floor; soft review with no credit pull to start.

## Key facts
- Minimum approval: $100,000 (guaranteed on files formally accepted onto the desk)
- Capital delivered: $840M+ across 1,280 operators
- Approval rate: 99% of accepted files close at quoted terms
- Capital partners: 100+ private lenders
- Time to fund: 24 hours – 6 days

## Financing instruments
- Working Capital Lines ($100K–$10M, revolving)
- Term Loans (12–60 mo, no prepayment penalty)
- Bridge Loans (same week)
- Equipment & Asset Finance (collateralized)
- Commercial Real Estate (senior / mezzanine)
- Business Line of Credit, Accounts Receivable Financing, 0% Credit Stacking,
  Asset Based Lending, SBA Loans, Personal Loans, Short Term Business Loans

## Industries
Real Estate (flagship), Construction, Healthcare, Retail / E-commerce, Restaurants,
Trucking & Logistics, Manufacturing, Home Services, Professional Services

## How it works
1. Submit your file (bank statements, tax returns, denial letters)
2. Strategy call with a dedicated partner
3. Matched to the single most likely lender
4. Funded — wire to your account

## Disclosure
Credify is a financing facilitator, not a lender or bank. Capital is provided by third-party lending partners; terms vary by file and lender. Not a commitment to lend.
